title: Chapter 31
text: From the Author Dearest Reader, It is my sincerest hope that you find yourself within these pages and it feeds your soul with the truth that you are irreplaceable—for exactly who you are, right now . May you never let anyone put you in a corner or tell you to heel. Fight your way forward and don’t look back—there is nothing for you there. Your only trajectory is forward. When things turn rocky and rough, and you feel you cannot go on, I hope the Sisters whisper in your ear that you.are.enough. I adore connecting with my readers. I do so mostly through my email list which you can sign up for at jlvampa.com, or through Instagram, @jlvampa. I hope to see you on the rest of this journey with the Sisters Solstice. WINTER OF THE WICKED COMING 2023 Best Wishes & Dark Tidings, J.L. Instagram
